nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Parametric Regの一種とも、Nonparametric Interval Estimation の一種だとも言えず。単純な 平均と標準偏差に基づく統計的な標準化（Zスコアの算出）。ただこれを Others:UNKNOWN/N と表現するのは適切かどうか違和感が残る。他にこのような単純なZスコア算出研究があるのであれば新たなキーワードを定義すべきとも思う。
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: To obtain normative models, the mean μ and standard deviation σ of the power spectra were calculated across the subjects from the normative dataset (Fig 1B). These statistics were then used for converting the power spectrum matrices for the patients and their healthy controls, into deviations maps of Z-scores over the entire cortex

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Source-level power spectral densities (PSDs) were computed from resting-state MEG recordings at cortical locations. The PSDs were binned into six canonical frequency bands: delta (1-4 Hz), theta (4-8 Hz), alpha (8-13 Hz), low beta (13-17 Hz), high beta (17-30 Hz), and gamma (30-40 Hz). The spatial dimension was parcellated into 448 cortical regions.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: An automated source-modeling pipeline was applied on the measurements to compute power spectral densities (PSDs) at each cortical location using the MNE-Python software.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: No covariates reported; normative model uses reference-sample mean and standard deviation only.
